autosave: The edits are saved automatically · A version will be created once the document is closed
historyHint: The versions of the document and who edited it
noVersions: There are none yet — a version is created once the last editor leaves the document.

restoreConfirm.message: The editor will close and open again. The present content stays in the history — the restore can be undone.
restoreConfirm.title: Restore version {n} as the current one?

restoreHint: Make this version the current content
saveVersionHint: Freeze the current content as a separate version
shareHint: Share a link with someone who has no account
shareNote: The guest will see the document as a PDF — a readable copy of the current content. Editing it or opening the source by the link is not possible.
switchToEditHint: Switch to editing: the changes will be seen by everyone who has access to the file
